pli-tv-kd12:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.

pli-tv-kd12:1.1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti

pli-tv-kd12:1.1.7: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave pārivāsikā bhikkhū sādiyanti pakatattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ …pe… nahāne piṭṭhiparikamma”nti.
pli-tv-kd12:1.1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave pārivāsikā bhikkhū sādiyissanti pakatattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ, sāmīcikammaṃ āsanābhihāraṃ seyyābhihāraṃ pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakaṭhalikaṃ pattacīvarapaṭiggahaṇaṃ nahāne piṭṭhiparikammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:1.1.27: anujānāmi bhikkhave pārivāsikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mithu yathābuḍḍhaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ āsanābhihāraṃ seyyābhihāraṃ pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakaṭhalikaṃ pattacīvarapaṭiggahaṇaṃ nahāne piṭṭhiparikammaṃ.”

pli-tv-kd12:1.1.30: tena hi bhikkhave pārivāsikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā pārivāsikehi bhikkhūhi vattitabbaṃ.

pli-tv-kd12:9.1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma abbhānārahā bhikkhū sādiyissanti pakatattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ …pe… nahāne piṭṭhiparikammanti.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.7: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave abbhānārahā bhikkhū sādiyanti pakatattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ …pe… nahāne piṭṭhiparikamma”nti?
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.11: nāma bhikkhave abbhānārahā bhikkhū sādiyissanti pakatattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ …pe… nahāne piṭṭhiparikammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.20: anujānāmi bhikkhave abbhānārahānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mithu yathābuḍḍhaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ …pe… nahāne piṭṭhiparikammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.21: anujānāmi bhikkhave abbhānārahānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pañca yathābuḍḍhaṃ:
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.23: tena hi bhikkhave abbhānārahānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā abbhānārahehi bhikkhūhi vattitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.28: na bhikkhūhi sampayojetabbaṃ. (yathā mūlāyapaṭikassanārahassa vattaṃ, tathā mānattārahassa ca mānattacārikassa ca abbhānārahassa cā ti tiṇṇaṃ ekasadisaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.29: na bhikkhave abbhānārahena bhikkhunā pakatattassa bhikkhuno purato gantabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.31: yo hoti saṅghassa āsanapariyanto seyyāpariyanto vihārapariyanto so tassa padātabbo. tena ca so sāditabbo.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.32: na bhikkhave abbhānārahena bhikkhunā pakatattena bhikkhunā puresamaṇena vā
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.36: na ca tappaccayā piṇḍapāto nīharāpetabbo ‘mā maṃ jāniṃsū’ti.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.37: na bhikkhave abbhānārahena bhikkhunā sabhikkhukā āvāsā abhikkhuko āvāso gantabbo aññatra pakatattena aññatra antarāyā.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.38: na bhikkhave abbhānārahena bhikkhunā sabhikkhukā āvāsā abhikkhuko anāvāso gantabbo, aññatra pakatattena aññatra antarāyā.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.41: gantabbo bhikkhave abbhānārahena bhikkhunā sabhikkhukā āvāsā …pe…
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.43: āvāsā vā anāvāsā vā sabhikkhuko āvāso …pe…
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.45: sabhikkhuko āvāso vā anāvāso vā, yatthassu bhikkhū samānasaṃvāsakā, yaṃ jaññā sakkomi ajjeva gantunti.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.46: na bhikkhave abbhānārahena bhikkhunā pakatattena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekacchanne āvāse vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.48: na ekacchanne āvāse vā anāvāse vā vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.51: na pakatattena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekāsane nisīditabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.52: na nīce āsane nisinne ucce āsane nisīditabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.55: na nīce caṅkame caṅkamante ucce caṅkame caṅkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.57: na bhikkhave abbhānārahena bhikkhunā pārivāsikena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ …pe…
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.61: abbhānārahena buḍḍhatarena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekacchanne āvāse vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.63: na ekacchanne āvāse vā anāvāse vā vatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.65: na nīce āsane nisinne ucce āsane nisīditabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.68: na nīce caṅkame caṅkamante ucce caṅkame caṅkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.73: tabbīso abbheyya, akammaṃ. na ca karaṇīyanti.
